description: This file implements classes and methods for handling certificate errors, including error reporting, string conversion, and error collection management within the 'net' namespace.

classes.name: CertError
classes.description: Represents a single certificate error with severity, ID, and optional parameters.

classes.name: CertErrors
classes.description: A collection of CertError instances, providing methods to add, query, and generate debug strings.

classes.name: CertPathErrors
classes.description: Manages errors associated with a chain of certificates, including per-certificate errors and overall errors.

methods.name: AppendLinesWithIndentation
methods.description: Appends each line of a given text with specified indentation to an output string.

methods.name: CertError::ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the CertError for debugging.

methods.name: CertErrors::Add
methods.description: Adds a new CertError with specified severity, ID, and parameters.

methods.name: CertErrors::AddError
methods.description: Adds a high severity error with specified ID and optional parameters.

methods.name: CertErrors::AddWarning
methods.description: Adds a warning error with specified ID and optional parameters.

methods.name: CertErrors::ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a combined debug string for all contained errors.

methods.name: CertPathErrors::GetErrorsForCert
methods.description: Retrieves errors associated with a specific certificate index.

methods.name: CertPathErrors::GetOtherErrors
methods.description: Returns errors not associated with any specific certificate.

methods.name: CertPathErrors::ToDebugString
methods.description: Generates a detailed string of all certificate errors and chain errors.
